first_batch_drafts.body:
Dear Michael Flynn,

I'm reaching out because Skidmore, Owings & Merrill (SOM) is recognized as a leader in designing premium Mid-rise & Corporate HQ projects—exactly where Glas Expert delivers differentiation.

We specialize in custom architectural glass solutions that give your projects a competitive edge:

Available this week for a quick call.

Bogdan Gheorghita
Business Development | Glas Expert USA
